# Revenue-Growth.ai

> Six-month AI GTM / RevOps embed. Data cleanup first, then process, then agents. Your stack first. The platform is included when it fits.

Revenue-Growth.ai embeds for six months as an AI GTM / RevOps engineer. The work starts in the client’s own stack — Salesforce or HubSpot — with data cleanup, then process, then agents that research and draft. People still approve the send. They keep the handoff. The platform is included when it fits; it is not the lead offer.

Primary deep read: [Fractional AI GTM: who it’s for and what six months buys](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/fractional-ai-gtm-embed/).

## Primary deep read

- [Fractional AI GTM: who it’s for and what six months buys](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/fractional-ai-gtm-embed/): Who a fractional AI GTM / RevOps embed is for, and what six months of data cleanup, process, then agents buys. Platform included when it fits.

Wrong About Who Does It for RevOps.](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/cuban-custom-revops-embed/): Mark Cuban is right that utilization wins; for RevOps the fix isn’t another GTM wrapper. It’s an embed that cleans data, fixes process, then puts agents in your stack.
- [Per-task automation billing doesn’t scale](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/per-task-automation-billing/): Why Make, Zapier, and n8n Cloud bills track CRM event volume — and why the path out is a six-month embed (data → processes → agents), with capacity-based runtime included when it fits.
- [Grok Bot for business, OpenClaw for enterprise, and Hermes for business](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/grok-bot-for-business/): Personal teammate agents vs coverage of the book via a six-month embed — data → processes → agents.

- [AI Lead Routing & Inbound Acceleration](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/lead-routing.html): Use-case page on inbound intent, account research, and rep routing for Salesforce and HubSpot.

## Proof

- AskNicely — lifted forecasted win rate 18% and doubled qualified pipeline in the same quarter.
